rationale: The raw schedule row states a reference spread of S + 6.00% and separately reports an all-in interest rate of 9.93% including 3.50% PIK. The extracted identifier instead reports S + 9.50%, exactly 6.00% + 3.50%, showing that the PIK component was incorrectly added to the reference spread. The spread field is therefore wrong; the source value is 6.00%.
